corrections.old_text: እለ ፡ ምሉዐን፡ ሰብዓተ፡ መቅሠፍተ፡ ደኃርያተ ፡ ወተ
corrections.corrected_text: እለ ፡ ምሉዓን፡ ሰብዓተ፡ መቅሠፍተ፡ ደኃርያተ ፡ ወተ
corrections.reason: The printed glyph in ምሉዓን has the shortened right leg of 4th-order ዓ (matching the standard Ge'ez plural participle ምሉዓን).
Visual inspection of Col 4 L08 shows 2nd-order ቱ in both ዐሠርቱ and ወክልኤቱ and 6th-order ት in ምእት (nominative predicate after ወኮነ).
